info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to shake, to tremble, to quake, to shiver

entries.artha_hindi: GabarAnA, hicakicAnA, jora se kAMpanA, TaraTaranA

examples: 'svaDarmamapi cAvekzya na vikampitumarhasi' (gItA 2.31). vikampitum, vicalitum, vyaTitum, vihvalitum.
'svasTAnAnna vikampeta' (BA0 vi0 109). na vikampeta=na nivarteta, na vyAvarteta. svaM sTAnaM na rahayedityarTaH.
'vadanaM tad vadAnyAyA vEdehyA na vikampate' (rA0 2.60.17). nAsyA vAk sajjati BAzaBARAyA ityarTaH.
'ASlizyamARaH priyayA SaNkaropi yadAjYayA. utkampate saBuvanaM sa jayatyasamasAyakaH' (kaTA0 15.2).. utkampate'titarAM depate.
'somavikrayiRaM hiraRyenABikampayati' (kA0 SrO0 7.8.15). aBikampayati vicAlayati praloBayati, garDayati.

examples.text: duDuve ca sa romARi cakampe cAcalopamaH
